devdoc.details: Extracted from BaseEscrow to reduce contract size (Phase 2 size optimization)      Key design principles (from updated plan):      - Compute → Apply: Returns escalation result, BaseEscrow applies to state      - No callbacks: Does not write to BaseEscrow state      - Atomic: Single call computes all escalation logic      - View-ish: Could be view function but module may update counters      Pattern:      BaseEscrow calls: computeEscalation(workflowId, caller, escrowData)      DisputeOps returns: (newResolver, newLevel, escalationFee)      BaseEscrow applies: Updates state and collects fees

computeEscalation(address,uint256,addres.details: This function is "compute-only" - it does NOT modify BaseEscrow state.      It may call the resolution module which might update its own counters.      BaseEscrow will apply the result after receiving it.

params.amountAfterFee: Amount after fee deduction (what's actually held in escrow)
params.caller: Address initiating the escalation (msg.sender from BaseEscrow)
